name: Hyperliquid Malaysia
rootCause: On August 6, 2026, the Hyperliquid Malaysia community treasury suffered a private key compromise on Solana. No confirmed transaction or loss figure has been published. The incident affected a local group's wallet and not the Hyperliquid trading protocol itself. The incident was caused by the compromise of the private key controlling the Hyperliquid Malaysia community treasury wallet. The reviewed statements do not confirm exactly how the key was obtained or what method enabled the attacker to access the wallet.
